applies_to: YORK YST steam-turbine-driven centrifugal chillers fitted with the SC-EQ communication card.
summary: YORK by Johnson Controls YST chillers drive a centrifugal compressor with a steam turbine. The SC-EQ communication card exposes them on BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU / N2). Remote commands are run/stop, leaving chilled water setpoint and a turbine horsepower limit; the rest is read-only: chiller and turbine temperatures, pressures, speed, steam flow, bearing and hotwell values, contact states, and multistate status and fault codes.
notes: Access is inferred: the sheet has no read/write column. The remote block (AV 1-2, BV 1) is treated as commandable and MV 65001 as writable; everything else as read-only.

Status-code MVs (operation, fault, warning, modified run, start inhibit, internal fault) are the printed code + 1, as the doc's status code tables say. MVs with their own enum in the points table (Units, control sources) are shown as printed, from 0; BACnet multistate values start at 1, so the card may report the printed number + 1. Confirm by discovery.
Units shown are the IP units; with MV 65001 set to SI the card reports °C, kPa and so on.
Spare objects in the sheet (AV 3-4, AV 42, BV 2-4, BV 21, BV 25, MV 10) have no name and are left out.

integration.summary: Run and stop it with BV 1, write the leaving chilled water setpoint (AV 1) and the turbine horsepower limit (AV 2). Read MV 1 and MV 6 for chiller and turbine state, the leaving water temperature and PRV position, and MV 2/MV 3 for safety and cycling shutdowns.

minimum_points.name: UNIT CONTROL SOURCE
minimum_points.why: Control source; ISN (BAS) for BMS control

integration.enable: BV 1 REM RUN STOP CMD (0 = Stop, 1 = Run) is the BAS run/stop, and AV 1-2 are the remote setpoints. MV 5 Unit Control Source shows Local, ISN, Analog, Digital or Modem, and BV 20 shows the remote-mode ready-to-start contacts. The points list has no write-enable point and doesn't say how the source is chosen at the chiller panel.
setup: The BAS connects to the SC-EQ J12 port (RS-485: +, -, COM/REF, SHLD). The card detects BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2 and the baud rate by itself; allow up to 120 seconds after power-up.
The MAC address (1-127) is set on DIP switch SW1 (switch 8 unused). Cycle the card's power after changing it.

The device instance defaults to 5000 + the MAC address (MAC 6 gives 5006). To use another number, set Device Instance Mode to Manual and enter the instance with the SC-AP / MAP tool, or write BV 65000 (mode) and AV 65000 (instance ID).
MV 65001 Units sets whether the BAS sees IP or SI values, independent of the chiller display; set it to match the chiller.
gotchas: The remote (commandable) setpoints read as unreliable until the BAS writes them the first time.
The SC-EQ only exposes the points that apply to the chiller it detects; if it replaces an E-Link, re-discover the device so old non-applicable points don't sit offline.
A start goes through turbine slow roll and ramp-up; watch MV 6 rather than expecting the chiller to load right after BV 1.
